basic_info.description: Settled on the top of sun-kissed southern hill of Bernal Heights, this newly constructed two-unit building embodies the practicality of comfort modern living. Upper unit contains 2Bed+den/2Bath, lower unit features 3Bed+den/3Bath on two levels. The open living and dining rooms flow to the custom traditional style kitchens, finished with stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, matte tiled backsplash and robust prep islands with wine coolers. Two serene bedrooms, a spacious den and two bathrooms complete main levels, optimized for urban lifestyle. The lower unit offers an additional level with soaring ceilings, gracefully comprised of en-suite bedroom and flexible family room that opens to spacious back patio.    Situated on top of the sun-kissed southern Bernal hill, the home provides easy access to vibrant Cortland village, lush St.Mary's Playground and Holy Park, Alemany market, and 280 freeway.
